meta.title: Secrets: Manage secure values inside any resource
meta.body:
This PR adds generic support for defining or referencing secure values withiin any resource. It adds a top level "secure" section that lives next to "spec". (alternativly we could consider making it a property on spec, but that may lead to weird behaviors depending on how spec is defined) Consider a resource like: ``` apiVersion: testdata.datasource.grafana.app/v0alpha1 kind: DataSource metadata: name: sample-testdata spec: title: Sample datasource url: http://... secure: sampleA: create: secret value here # replaced with a name on write sampleB: name: XYZ # reference to a existing secret ``` When writing to unistore, this will automatically process the secure section so any raw values are replaced with a reference: ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor User participant apistore participant secrets participant unistore User->>apistore: Update resource
with secrets apistore->>secrets: CreateInline A apistore->>secrets: CreateInline B apistore->>unistore: Create/Update/Delete unistore->>secrets: CanReference apistore->>secrets: DeleteInline C
(if required from changes) apistore->>User: success ``` The apistore is responsible for managing the inline secrets explicitly -- eventually we will likely have a garbage collector for secrets, but that should only be required when create succeeds, but the following Write requests to unistore fail
